markers.reading: Zeno recalls visiting the mountain monastery and hearing its monks in childhood.

evidence.quote: Zeno: So the… auditory experience of the egg for Zeno unlocks for him a childhood memory he hadn't thought of in many years. It was… a trip when he… was a young dragonetling with his family to the interior mountains of the Circular Island where they went to visit a monastery populated by these strange… maybe were they flightless dragonets? They, they never flew. They were… serious and calm. As a little one, he felt this was boring at first. He was introduced to one of them as his uncle Kaz.

Zeno: And… In the evening, he was brought to a ritual that these dragonet monks were performing and at the ritual, he heard a sound, unlike any he'd heard before, of the dragonets performing a drone that came from deep in their bodies, a kind of choral singing.

markers.reading: Heska recalls hunting over the ocean near the storm after a childhood performance.

markers.reading: Sculpit recalls becoming lost in a shifted storm and unexpectedly appearing back on the Wanderer’s hand.

evidence.quote: Sculpit: At one point, There was some… bob… you know, thing out in the ocean, a floating stick or something that was really far away from shore, and the question was, well, who could go get it the first or the fastest? And Sculpit flew off, and…
All of a sudden, he found himself surrounded by thunder and lightning
And he appeared back on the Wanderer's hand.

markers.note: The remembered race began over the ocean; the relocation is described as sudden and unexplained.
